name: WNBA_R1A3_ESPN_PRIOR_GAME_SOURCE_CERTIFICATION_V1

candidate_source.intended_role: prior-game schedule and boxscore source for point-in-time reconstruction

scientific_interpretation.reason: Every season-level scoreboard request received HTTP 403 before any event or summary payload could be inspected. Access denial is not evidence that the historical games or boxscores do not exist.

anti_leakage_guards: Only June 1-7 prior-game windows were requested for hypothetical June 15 target dates.
No hypothetical target-date game was requested.
No target outcome, market price or injury inference was requested.
Prior-game outcomes are permitted only as information that would already have been known before the hypothetical target cutoff.
HTTP 403 may not be converted into zero/default statistics.
allowed_next_actions: Audit a static, versioned historical WNBA game/boxscore dataset accessible from the research environment.
Retest ESPN from a network environment where access is demonstrated without changing scientific rules.
Use a credentialed historical provider only after source custody and as-of rules are frozen before target outcomes are opened.
prohibited_next_actions: Declare ESPN historical WNBA coverage absent based on HTTP 403.
Fill inaccessible ESPN inputs with zeros or current values.
Use target-game boxscores to infer pregame state.
Open target outcomes before choosing and freezing the fallback source.
